messages:
Alex: obs-bot fired a token_latency_p99 alert for prod us-west-2 on rwd-gpt-3b-quant, p99 jumped >2.2s starting ~21:01 UTC
obs-bot: ALERT: token_latency_p99 > 2200ms (30s) — prod-us-west-2 — model=rwd-gpt-3b-quant — firing :bangbang:
Priya: can you drop the grafana link + the promql you're using for the panel? :eyes:
Alex: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/AbC123/token-latency?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2
Alex: panel promql: sum by(model_variant)(histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])))
Jorge: noticed tokens/sec collapsed during the window as well. quick promql I ran: rate(tokens_emitted_total{region="us-west-2",model=~"rwd.*"}[1m])
Jorge: short numbers: rwd-gpt-3b-quant tokens/sec ~ 280 -> 45 at 21:01
Mei: logs show a KV cache miss storm around that time, which would cause recompute and push latencies up. snippet below:
```
[2027-02-02T21:02:58Z] kvcache: miss key=conv-7b1 model=rwd-gpt-3b-quant prefix_len=128
[2027-02-02T21:03:00Z] kvcache: miss key=conv-2f4 model=rwd-gpt-3b-quant prefix_len=64
[2027-02-02T21:03:01Z] kvcache: miss key=conv-a90 model=rwd-gpt-3b-quant prefix_len=256
```
Mei: more misses == more recompute. matches the throughput drop + p99 spike
Priya: could be cache evictions due to memory pressure / OOM on the pod. can someone check node events and pod restart history for g4dn-pool-7 around 21:00?
Jorge: ran quick cluster-checks:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep rwd-gpt-3b-quant
kubectl describe pod rwd-gpt-3b-quant-7f6 | sed -n '1,120p'
kubectl get events -n inference --field-selector involvedObject.name=rwd-gpt-3b-quant-7f6
```
Jorge: found one pod OOMKilled at 2027-02-02T21:01:15Z, kubelet restarted it. node g4dn-pool-7 showed memory pressure warnings.
Alex: that explains cold cache and the transient tokens/sec drop. cost/per-token increased because more recompute and lower amortized throughput.
Priya: proposal to reduce pager noise and avoid paging on single-pod blips:
- widen p99 eval window in grafana from 5m -> 15m
- guard the p99 calculation to ignore tiny-throughput windows (avoid spurious percentiles when tokens/sec ~ 0)
Example guarded promql we can use in the panel:
```
# compute per-variant tokens/sec
valid_rate = sum by(model_variant)(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m]))
# only compute p99 when we have steady traffic
p99_guarded = (histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) unless (valid_rate < 10))
```
Priya: also will add a small `unless` clause on the alert so it doesn't page when tokens/sec < 20 for that variant
Mei: suggest adding two more panels to the dashboard: a tokens/sec per-pod heatmap and a kvcache miss-rate panel by model_variant/pod. that helps root-cause without paging SREs
Jorge: ops mitigation: increase memory request for rwd-gpt-3b-quant pods on g4dn-pool-7 from 12Gi -> 16Gi to avoid OOMs. will do a canary rollout restricted to west2 first.
Alex: +1 to the memory bump. let's canary in us-west-2 only, don't change other regions yet. schedule rollout during low-latency windows (after 02:00 UTC).
Priya: for the alert tuning I'll open an infra PR with: panel window change, guarded promql, and alert update with tokens/sec suppression. I'll also add runbook notes: when OOMKilled event seen -> check kvcache miss-rate -> consider memory bump or evict noisy pod.
Alex: owners:
- PR for grafana + alert: @Priya (ETA 2h)
- memory request canary and roll: @Jorge (ETA 3h)
- follow-up: add kvcache instrumentation to panel: @Mei (ETA EOD)
Priya: tagging the incident: #inc-2027-02-02-west2-kvcache-oom :spiral_note_pad:
Jorge: rolling canary now on a single pod (rwd-gpt-3b-quant-7f6) — monitoring tokens/sec and p99 in 5m increments :eyes:
Mei: headroom check: node g4dn-pool-7 has ~2 pods with <10% free mem after bump; will watch for scheduling pressure.
Alex: thanks team. if canary looks good we'll roll the memory request cluster-wide for the variant. otherwise we revert and investigate further (possible memory leak in this model container) :thumbsup:
obs-bot: RESOLVED: token_latency_p99 — prod-us-west-2 — model=rwd-gpt-3b-quant — ended after pod restart and initial cache warmup (alert cleared at 21:12 UTC)
Priya: postmortem note: short-term config change (memory bump + alert guard). long-term: identify kvcache eviction root cause and add metric for eviction-by-reason (OOM vs LRU).
Alex: creating a follow-up ticket in infra backlog with links to logs + grafana panels.
